name: Gengetsu no Pandora
source:
One day, Fumiki joins the game research club. When he goes to the club room, hot water suddenly comes out from the ground! Also, a girl appears in front of him and plugs a cable into his chest. When he regains his consciousness, he finds himself being in a digital world. There, a girl suddenly appears and says to him, "Collect some data of human desire..."

When he comes back to his world, his portable game console changes into something different... The console is called "Pandora" that makes human desire something like a game. With this strange game console, what kind of games will be created...?

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
一天，文树加入了游戏研究部。他来到社团活动室时，地下突然涌出热水！随后，一名少女出现在他面前，把一根电缆插进他的胸口。恢复意识后，他发现自己身处数字世界。在那里，一名少女突然现身，对他说道：“收集一些人类欲望的数据…”

回到现实世界后，他的便携式游戏机变成了另一种东西…这台名为“Pandora”的游戏机能把人类欲望化作游戏。凭借这台奇怪的游戏机，究竟会创造出怎样的游戏…？

[摘自ErogeShop]
